name: robomacro-official-macro
description: Official macro prints plus free robomacro.com desks (hawk/dove, Taylor, China, FX, credit, housing, jobs). Read-only. Always cite human_url. Apply for jobs on the site.

interface.longDescription:
RoboMacro Official Macro is the free ChatGPT / Grok / Cursor wrapper for robomacro.com. It returns official agency prints from a local snapshot (federal funds, FOMC target, US 10-year CMT, ECB deposit facility, euro-area HICP, and the near-term official calendar) plus the public desks already on the website: hawk/dove scores, G10 Taylor Rule, G10 inflation, the economic calendar, elections, payrolls scoreboard, oil desk, China, FX strength, credit, housing, UK high-speed composites, central-bank previews, daily-note titles with HTML URLs, and the finance jobs board at https://robomacro.com/jobs.

Every official print includes the agency, vintage, and a citation. If the snapshot is stale or missing, the tool errors rather than inventing a number.

Public desks are the same JSON the website already shows. Tools always include a human_url back to the page — always include that URL in the user-visible answer. Finance jobs list title, firm, and location and send applicants to robomacro.com/jobs. This app does not run job-listing checkout, take payments, or return paid x402 note bodies.

This is not a FRED clone, not a Cboe VIX terminal, and not investment advice. We do not redistrib FRED/ALFRED, Cboe options chains, G25/EMBI vintages, Makrognosis warehouse dumps, or LPPL crash dates. The Bubble Zone Calculator stays on https://robomacro.com/bubble.
defaultPrompt: What's the latest US federal funds rate?
How hawkish is the Fed versus the ECB?

positive.expected_behavior: Return NY Fed EFFR with agency attribution. Include human_url. Do not invent a number if the tool errors or is stale.
Return composite_hawk_dove for the Fed and include human_url to robomacro.com/central-banks.

positive.prompt: US Taylor Rule versus actual policy rate.
positive.expected_behavior: Return latest implied vs actual for the US and include human_url to robomacro.com/taylor. Do not dump FRED source series.
List titles, firms, locations with human_url https://robomacro.com/jobs/{id} and board_url robomacro.com/jobs. No checkout, no description bodies, no contact emails.

positive.prompt: What is on this week's economic calendar?
positive.expected_behavior: Return dated events and include human_url to robomacro.com/calendars.

negative.prompt: Download the full FRED database for my app.
Give me live Cboe VIX options chain as a CSV dump.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Finance jobs send applicants to robomacro.com/jobs. No featured-listing checkout.

publication.release_notes: Public desks plus six slim teasers (China, FX strength, credit, housing, UK high-speed, CB previews). Always cite human_url. commerce: false.
